Game Overview

Dungeon Knight is a escape game built around navigate treacherous dungeons in Dungeon Knight, where every move requires strategy and quick thinking. Brave deadly traps, outsmart blobs, and collect vital power-ups. Master your knight's journey to freedom with intuitive controls and a math-based combat system, testing your precision in an escalating labyrinth of danger.
